ideas.title: Uncovering Daycare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of daycare fraud in Minnesota and the Trump administration's attempt to freeze federal childcare funding.
questions: What is the extent of daycare fraud in Minnesota?
How has the Trump administration's attempt to freeze federal childcare funding affected daycare providers in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: I believe that there is a large-scale daycare fraud scheme in Minnesota, and the Trump administration's attempt to freeze federal childcare funding may be an attempt to cover it up. Further investigation is needed to uncover the truth.
